findings.title: Create a separate selection for each window
findings.root_cause: AppServices.makeWindow injects the same process-owned Selection into every WindowModel.
consequences: Selection in one window changes other windows.
A new window inherits a prior document selection.
Restoration overwrites selection in another scene.

findings.title: Keep the deployment target at iOS 17
findings.trigger: Both app configurations now inherit IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 18.0 from the target xcconfig.
findings.consequence: The release excludes installation and update on explicitly supported iOS 17.
findings.authority: PRODUCT.md at exact head; base configuration; supplied build log target triples.
findings.pass_condition: App and hosted-test Debug/Release resolve iOS 17.0; focused support-contract check and relevant build/tests on repaired exact head.

findings.title: Keep iPad in the supported device family
findings.trigger: Both app configurations inherit TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY = 1 from the target xcconfig.
findings.consequence: Native iPad targeting is removed from the previously universal release.
findings.authority: PRODUCT.md at exact head and complete target/project configuration chain.
findings.pass_condition: App and hosted-test Debug/Release resolve device families 1,2; focused support-contract check.
